subject.title: Exec/tool failures show "(see attached image)" and suppress model response

question: Should this issue remain the umbrella for the combined placeholder-plus-silent-turn regression, or should maintainers split closure between the provider placeholder issues and the replay-unsafe incomplete-turn issue?
rationale: Current main has partial source fixes and several open related tracks, but the remaining recovery policy can affect side-effect replay safety and channel-visible diagnostics.

options.title: Keep umbrella open
options.body: Keep this issue open until the open provider replay PRs and the replay-unsafe incomplete-turn policy have explicit outcomes.

options.title: Split to canonical tracks
options.body: Close this later only after preserving the reports on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/96857 and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97324.

options.title: Close after provider proof only
options.body: Treat the no-reply portion as out of scope here, which is faster but risks losing the user-visible silent-turn part of the report.

recommendation.title: Keep umbrella open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until the open provider replay PRs and the replay-unsafe incomplete-turn policy have explicit outcomes.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame and release provenance point to this area through Vincent's recent main/release commits, with adjacent provider and runner owners also identified above.
